title: 新製品・サービス開発
subtitle: Value Creation for New Product and Service
educationalGoal: This course is designed to give you a broad overview of the subject of Innovation management and value creation, and provide you with information about value engineering skills. You will be introduced to a variety of concepts, tools and techniques that are important for understanding the value engineering by lecture and practice.
advice: In order to make it easier to understand how to use value engineering in product development and service development, the lecturer develops the class as follows. In the lecture, the ability to think and practice by conducting the exercise based on concrete products is developed. In addition, the VE approach is based on a teamwork approach, so we hope that you will strive to improve leadership and collaboration skills through team activities.
books: Textbook is not determined, but Instructor will use following books as reference.
requiredKnowledge: It is important not to study the theory of value engineering, but to understand the concept of value improvement and the process and method of implementing VE, and to acquire the ability to actually use it for product development and service development. Therefore, if you are interested in products that are familiar to you on a daily basis, are interested in its function, performance, and cost, and you collect product brochures, etc., you can improve your understanding and interest in the course. In addition, project design II, problem analysis of practice, it may be studied in conjunction with these subjects because it is also effective content as a solution.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand and describe the concept of system thinking.
Ability to understand and apply the functional definition of value analysis
The ability to understand the functional evaluation of value analysis and to use value indices to improve value
The ability to consider alternatives to increase value.
Ability to apply value engineering to product planning, product design, etc. and explain it to third parties

achievementLevels.ideal: Ideal achievers can understand the concept of system thinking, and use VE in product development and service development to properly evaluate products, plan and evaluate value improvement proposals, and make third parties understand the results.
achievementLevels.standard: Standard achievers can understand the concept of system thinking, explain the role and effectiveness of VE in product development and service development, and consider product evaluation and value improvement proposals.
